Alex (CS): Orchid Health reserved pool warmup scheduled Wed 09:00 PT. Customer asks for no regressions, preferrably p95 < 120ms and p99 < 250ms once warmed. Need final quota + ramp approval.
Nora (SE): Proposed ramp plan: quick KV seed 10m @ 12rps, ramp 10m -> 40rps, 20m -> 90rps, 20m -> 150rps, then 45m soak at 150rps. Start canary on zone "orchid-usw-1" (2 replicas).
Diego (SRE): Autoscale policy suggestion: min 2, desired CPU target 55%, max 14 replicas. Add fast-path scale on queue_depth > 80.
Alex (CS): Customer requesting 250 concurrent token quota reserved for first 24h. Can we support that headroom?
Nora (SE): Yes, patching reserved config is fine. I'll create PR to bump reserved_tokens to 2500000 and set burst_token allowance.
Diego (SRE): Monitoring: abort if 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m; if p99 > 600ms for 3 intervals -> rollback; log error-rate and hallucination flag counts. We'll stream structured traces to debug-bucket/orchid-warmup with run_id tag. 30d retention.
Nora (SE): Load harness: k6 wrapper with synthetic prompts and header for customer API key. We'll seed KV cache with 12k quick prefix calls at 15rps for 8m. After soak collect sampling traces (1% of requests) and payload diffs.
Alex (CS): Please ensure only ops + SE can access debug-bucket. Customer wants an enablement call immediately after soak (15m) to walk the console and runbook.
infra-bot: Run created: "reserved-orchid-1770128462" watchers: Diego, Nora, Alex. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall and primary pager.
Diego (SRE): Small ask: can Orchid provide source IP allowlist and whether they require mTLS? If yes we need certs before warmup.
Alex (CS): I'll get IPs and cert expectations today and drop in onboarding doc.
Nora (SE): I'll upload k6 targets + PR link in thread by EOD. Targets include header template and example prompt list.
Diego (SRE): Action checklist: add temporary alert: queue_depth > 60 -> scale; high 429s -> throttle back ramp; enable short-term debug logs. I'll finish by tomorrow 11:00 PT.
Alex (CS): Schedule: Wed 09:00 PT start, 11:15 PT soak end, 11:30 PT enablement call. Abort policy: pause & huddle if any abort metric triggers.
Nora (SE): :thumbsup:
Diego (SRE): :thumbsup:
Alex (CS): Assigning owners: Alex - get IPs & certs; Nora - quota PR + targets; Diego - alerts + harness. Update here when done.
Nora (SE): PR opened: will paste link here when CI finishes.
Alex (CS): Thanks team — will ping customer and post confirmation in thread.
